# JSR EV SPARE PARTS

> JSR EV SPARE PARTS is an authorized retailer, wholesaler, and repair service provider for commercial electric rickshaws (e-rickshaws) and electric scooters based in Rohini Sector 18, Delhi, India. Established in 2024 by Deepak Choudhary, the shop provides genuine EV electrical and mechanical components, physical compatibility testing, battery charging, and in-shop repair and fitting services.

## Core Offerings & Services

1. **E-Rickshaw Spare Parts Supply:** Genuine motors, intelligent speed controllers, automatic SMPS chargers, differential rear axles, brake shoes, heavy-duty shockers, tyres, wiring harness kits, DC-DC step-down converters, LED headlights, tail lights, and throttle grips.
2. **In-Shop Testing & Fitting:** Same-day physical fitting, component testing, wiring inspection, and replacement in Sector 18, Rohini.
3. **Retail & Wholesale:** Serving individual e-rickshaw drivers, fleet operators, local mechanics, and spare-part dealers across Rohini, Badli, and North Delhi.

## Key Spare Part Categories

- [E-Rickshaw BLDC Motors](https://rohini.jsrevtech.in/products/erickshaw-motors): 48V & 60V high-torque copper-wound brushless DC motors (850W–1200W).
- [E-Rickshaw Speed Controllers](https://rohini.jsrevtech.in/products/controllers): 48V/60V intelligent brushless speed controllers (24-tube / 18-tube) with overheat and low-voltage protection.
- [E-Rickshaw Battery Chargers](https://rohini.jsrevtech.in/products/battery-chargers): Automatic SMPS battery chargers with auto-cutoff and reverse polarity protection.
- [E-Rickshaw Differentials](https://rohini.jsrevtech.in/products/differentials): Alloy steel differential rear axle assemblies (33-inch, 35-inch) for smooth cornering and heavy load endurance.
- [E-Rickshaw Brake Shoes](https://rohini.jsrevtech.in/products/brake-shoes): High-friction, heat-resistant drum brake shoes for front and rear e-rickshaw brakes.
- [E-Rickshaw Shock Absorbers](https://rohini.jsrevtech.in/products/shock-absorbers): Hydraulic suspension shockers designed for commercial Delhi road conditions.
- [E-Rickshaw Tyres & Tubes](https://rohini.jsrevtech.in/products/tyres): Commercial 3.75-12 e-rickshaw tyres with high ply ratings and puncture resistance.
- [E-Rickshaw Wiring Harness Kits](https://rohini.jsrevtech.in/products/wiring-kits): Full copper vehicle wiring harness kits with flame-retardant sleeves and waterproof couplers.
- [E-Rickshaw DC Converters](https://rohini.jsrevtech.in/products/dc-converters): 48V/60V to 12V DC step-down converters for horns, headlights, and accessories.
- [E-Rickshaw Headlights](https://rohini.jsrevtech.in/products/headlights): High-lumen, energy-efficient LED headlamps with durable impact-resistant lenses.
- [E-Rickshaw Tail Lights](https://rohini.jsrevtech.in/products/tail-lights): Rear brake lamps and indicator assemblies with weather-sealed casings.
- [E-Rickshaw Accelerators](https://rohini.jsrevtech.in/products/accelerators): Ergonomic throttle grips with integrated forward/reverse switches.
- [E-Rickshaw Battery Packs](https://rohini.jsrevtech.in/products/battery-packs): Commercial high-cycle lead-acid and lithium battery packs with verified warranty support.
